official.status_note: 2027-2028 applications are open; application deadline January 15, 2027; programmes begin in September 2027.

Published funding: tuition waivers of 25%, 50%, 75%, or 100%, plus a small number of fully funded scholarships, which may also include a living stipend, depending on the award.
official.funding_period: one-off per academic year; waiver of 25%-100%

application_method: Create an account in the BSE Application System at apply.bse.eu
Complete the application questions (up to 3 programmes may be listed) and upload the required documents
Pay the EUR 100 application fee by credit card or Flywire and submit
Have both referees upload their signed letters directly; the application is not complete until both letters have been uploaded
BSE automatically assesses eligibility for tuition waivers and promotes eligible candidates for scholarships provided by external funders; there is no separate scholarship application
official.application_route: One online application via the BSE Application System (apply.bse.eu); funding is assessed automatically from the admission application.
official.international_eligibility: No nationality restriction is published; BSE reports cohorts with students from over 50 countries and 83%-97% international students on individual programmes.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Applicants should hold a university diploma in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or Business Administration; candidates with academic backgrounds in other subjects are still considered.
official.research_requirement: No research proposal is required; a Statement of Purpose is mandatory and a Master's project is part of the programme. A GRE score is required only for the PhD Economics Track Program and is optional but recommended for the Economics Program.
official.duration: One academic year, September to July (1-year full-time, 60 ECTS)
official.description: The Barcelona School of Economics awards merit-based tuition waivers of 25%, 50%, 75% or 100%, plus a small number of fully funded scholarships that may include a living stipend, to admitted Master's students; funding is selected automatically from the admission application rather than through a separate scholarship process.
official.program_type: Merit-based tuition-fee waivers and fully funded scholarships for BSE Master's programmes
official.english_requirement: TOEFL 90; IELTS Academic 6.5; Duolingo English Test 120; Cambridge Proficiency or Advanced 176 minimum (B2-C2). Proof is not required for native English speakers or for those who completed their undergraduate degree at an English-speaking university.

applicant_utility.summary: There is no separate scholarship form to find here: every Master's application is automatically screened for tuition waivers of 25% to 100% and for a small pool of fully funded awards, so the strength of your admission file decides your money. Timing decides whether you compete at all, because a complete application by January 15, 2027 keeps you in the running for the full funding pool while late files only get whatever is left. Plan personal finances around a tuition-only award, since living support is attached only to the rare fully funded scholarship.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-GPA applicants from economics, finance, mathematics, engineering, statistics or business backgrounds who can submit a complete file well before January 15, 2027 and can self-fund Barcelona living costs.
application_readiness_checklist: Brief both referees before you start, because BSE will not count your file as complete until both signed letters are uploaded directly by them
Sit an accepted English test early; BSE advises waiting until you can meet the TOEFL 90 / IELTS 6.5 / Duolingo 120 / Cambridge 176 bar rather than applying without proof
Cut the CV to two pages and use the statement of purpose to spell out your recent mathematical and quantitative background

Request transcripts and the diploma now; if the degree is unfinished, obtain the signed declaration, and allow time for a sworn translation if documents are outside English, Spanish, Catalan, French, Italian or Portuguese
Confirm whether you are targeting the PhD Economics Track, the only route where a GRE score is mandatory
common_rejection_risks: A complete file that arrives after January 15, since those applicants are only considered for leftover funds
Referee letters that never reach the portal, leaving the application officially incomplete
A statement of purpose that never demonstrates recent quantitative or mathematical work
Applicants who assumed the waiver would also cover rent, food and flights and then cannot afford to matriculate
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Housing, food, transport, insurance and flights in Barcelona, plus the EUR 100 non-refundable application fee; a standard waiver reduces tuition only, and living support exists only within the few fully funded awards.
document_audit: Diplomas or transcripts in any other language need a sworn translation, so plan lead time
The CV has a hard two-page ceiling on the portal
Referee letters must show the referee's full name, work address and email, your name in the body, official letterhead and a signature
If the bachelor's is unfinished at submission, the signed declaration of expected completion is compulsory paperwork
GRE scores belong only to PhD Economics Track applications; sending them elsewhere adds nothing
alerts: January 15, 2027 is simultaneously the application deadline and the funding cut-off, making it the single date to work backwards from
The EUR 100 application fee is non-refundable and due before any decision is known
One application can list up to three programmes, which multiplies the chances of a funded offer without extra fees
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register at apply.bse.eu, complete the online form for up to three programme choices, upload all documents, pay EUR 100 by card or Flywire, then prompt your referees until both letters appear; the decision email delivers the admission result and any financial offer together.
